programs.desc: Traveling Silk Road into the Himalayas to search for rare beryl  the team races to India to bid for a Kashmir sapphire.

programs.title: America's Worst Tattoos: Got Ink?

programs.title: Deadliest Catch: Dedication
programs.desc: In the Winter premiere, the fleet reels from the loss of Summer Bay deck boss Nick McGlashan  Wizard and Cornelia launch early into a massive Arctic storm  Johnathan can't see eye-to-eye with a friend  shocking news forces Sig to change his plans.

programs.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier: New Frontiers, New Threats
programs.desc: Spring arrives early in Alaska, and the Kilchers are forced to prepare their homestead  3,000 miles away, Idaho's River of No Return roars back to life and the people who live on its shores must navigate the raging spring rapids.
